consensus.method: Mean of per-provider no-vig probabilities, re-normalized; median homeSpread and total.

odds.spreadConvention: homeSpread is the home team's spread: negative means the home team is favored (e.g. -3.5 = home gives 3.5).
odds.noVigMethod: Proportional: each outcome's implied probability divided by the sum across all outcomes (draw included for three-way markets).
